product.title: Shared Half-Day Mountain Tour in Red Rocks Evergreen and Echo Lake

description.text: Explore Colorado’s natural playgrounds, just a short drive from downtown Denver. Escape the city and head for the Rockies with a guide to handle the road, so you can focus on the stunning scenery of Mt. Evans, Bear Creek Canyon, and beyond. Stops include Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, Evergreen, Echo Lake, Mount Blue Sky, Bear Creek Canyon. Get a taste of mountain culture in the charming town of Evergreen, check out the dramatic formations of Red Rocks Amphitheatre, and hike around serene Echo Lake on this half-day mountain sampler. Ideal for visitors basing in Denver who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating transport, trailheads, or mountain logistics on their own.
